text:
{
  "status": "partial",
  "rpwd_relevant_sections": [
    "Section 31: Right to free education in an appropriate environment for children with benchmark disabilities up to 18 years",
    "Section 32: Five percent reservation and five-year upper age relaxation in higher educational institutions"
  ],
  "ncte_relevant_sections": [
    "NCTE/NCERT Guidelines p.32: Requirement for designing transition plans along with required transition support for CwDs",
    "NCTE/NCERT Guidelines p.30: Transaction of curriculum using adapted visual/tactile aids, accessible LTMs, and UDL-based flexible assessment procedures"
  ],
  "identified_gaps": [
    "Missing a formal, documented transition plan addressing board exam accommodations and preparation for higher education/college admissions, despite student reaching age 14 and explicitly requiring transition support under NCTE/NCERT Guidelines p.32"
  ],
  "mandatory_accommodations": [
    "Provision of large-print textbooks (18-24 point font) and learning materials as mandated by NCTE/NCERT Guidelines p.30",
    "Compensatory extra time (20 minutes per hour) and option for scribe/reader during examinations per RPwD Act guidelines and NCTE/NCERT flexible assessment standards",
    "Assistive technology access including screen-magnification software, electronic magnifiers (CCTV), and text-to-speech tools as per Section 31 of RPwD Act 2016 and NCTE/NCERT Guidelines p.30",
    "Formulated transition plan with specific targets for board exam preparation and higher education transition guidance pursuant to NCTE/NCERT Guidelines p.32 and Section 32 of RPwD Act 2016"
  ],
  "compliance_notes": "While the IEP adequately addresses immediate academic accommodations, assistive technology needs, and assessment modifications under Section 31 of RPwD Act 2016 and NCTE/NCERT Guidelines, it fails to include a structured transition plan. Under NCTE/NCERT Guidelines (p.32), a transition plan is mandatory for students aged 14+ to prepare for secondary board exams and higher education pathways (Section 32 RPwD Act). The audit verdict is partial compliance pending inclusion of explicit transition goals."
}
